title: Worker lanes cannot edit the main checkout
body:
Source: lead 2026-11-15: S3 lane (t-k3jmgax) and S20 lane (t-p14tych) both edited the main checkout instead of their lane worktree; the lead found main dirty with another lane's deletions.
Outcome: a krn-lane worker session that writes (Edit, Write or a mutating Bash) under the main checkout outside .krn/ is refused by the PreToolUse hook with exit 2 and a message naming its worktree.
Proof: a hook test with a worker session payload editing <main>/src/x.ts gets exit 2; the same edit under .krn/worktrees/<lane>/ passes.
Files: src/hook/scope.ts, src/hook/session.ts, test/hook/
